meta.name: Dhai Chaal
meta.description: An ambitious politician navigates the treacherous corridors of power, bending rules and forging alliances in a ruthless climb to the top. Morality blurs as survival demands compromise in this dark exploration of political machinations.

videos.title: Dhansu Ladke
videos.overview: Second-year student Mayur Bhardwaj and his friends get into a brawl with a campus bully, drawing them into the dangerous world of student politics.

videos.title: Butterfly Effect
videos.overview: As Mayur becomes popular on campus, he must decide whether to stay away from politics or fight for what he believes is right.

videos.title: Nukkad Natak
videos.overview: Mayur takes a stand against harassment and victim-blaming, bringing a new direction to the student movement.

videos.title: Andolan
videos.overview: A student protest turns into a major political fight, putting Mayur in the spotlight and bringing serious consequences.
